title: Deterministic real-NWB extraction and unit audit
current_best_explanation: A current best predictive model is not a meaningful category for this deterministic extraction contract; retain an audited correctness reference.
executed_endpoint: One legacy Allen intracellular NWB file shared with D02; six sweeps 19–24, 61 defined output fields: stored metadata, physical-unit conversions, main-pulse timing/amplitude and voltage summaries. extract(path) uses standard library, NumPy and h5py. Field accuracy, not predictive neuroscience performance.

existing_reference.name: Audited direct-HDF5 deterministic extraction, independently crosschecked against Allen sweep API and D02 arrays
existing_reference.evidence: A: exact contract and independent implementation/source checks; reference correctness is by construction.
existing_reference.strength: Appropriate for a deterministic parser/calculation fixture.
problems: A perfect reference score is tautological and is not measured specialist SOTA.
One file shares a dataset with D02, so breadth is not independent.
Does not establish general NWB standards compliance or robustness across formats.
existing_reference.verification_scope: Only the named locally audited reference/archived outputs, not every newer candidate or equal-budget/global optimality.

candidates.name: Direct HDF5 extraction with independent unit/timing implementation
candidates.evidence: C/A: audited local correctness route; software compatibility still explicit.
candidates.information_match: Best match to the legacy layout and allowed runtime; compare exact calculations, not learned predictions.

candidates.name: PyNWB current validated I/O
candidates.information_match: Useful for supported schema versions; legacy Allen NWB compatibility and any conversion must be checked, not assumed.

candidates.name: NWBInspector
candidates.information_match: Complementary structural/data-quality checks; does not compute this specific 61-field answer and is outside the existing import whitelist.

recommended_next_comparator: Keep independent HDF5/source-API correctness checks. Add PyNWB/NWBInspector as separate supported-format validation fixtures if broader NWB workflow coverage is desired.
switching_assessment: DO NOT replace a deterministic correctness reference with a predictive model. Tier A supports the existing calculation audit, Tier B supports complementary standards checks. Current best model is not applicable; new fixtures are needed to measure robustness.
limitations: Legacy schema may not be readable by current PyNWB without conversion.
NWBInspector findings are not extraction accuracy.
61 fields and six sweeps are correlated within one file/cell.
No held-out file, animal, lab or acquisition system.
Source data retain Allen research/noncommercial terms.
